name: JW Marriott Los Cabos Beach Resort & Spa
positioning: Beach resort in Puerto Los Cabos, San Jose del Cabo, where the Sea of Cortez meets the Pacific, with a temazcal spa, tiered ocean-facing pools and the Casa Maat butler retreat
best_for: Travelers who want a spa-focused beach stay in San Jose del Cabo
Golfers who want to be near the 27-hole Puerto Los Cabos course
Families with young children who want a kids club

facts.text: The resort is on the coastline of San Jose del Cabo, where the Sea of Cortez meets the Pacific Ocean.
The resort is in Puerto Los Cabos, San Jose del Cabo.
The resort was designed by IDEA Asociados and Olson Kunding Architects, with clean lines, stone, concrete and views of the Sea of Cortez.
The suites have a residential-like design by Jim Olson.
A room or suite at Casa Maat includes access to an exclusive pool, Jacuzzi, cabanas and a lounge.
Jasha Spa is inspired by natural healing ingredients found in the surrounding botanical garden.
Jasha Spa has 12 treatment rooms, an outdoor patio and garden, vitality pools and private Jacuzzis.
The nearby Puerto Los Cabos golf club has a 27-hole course with views of the Sea of Cortez from 70% of the course.
The resort partners with Flamingo Estate on an experience exploring scent, sound and taste.
The Kids Club welcomes children from 8 months to 12 years.
Cafe des Artistes, by chef Thierry Blouet, fuses Mexican cuisine with French elegance, with live piano music each evening.
MarHumo celebrates Baja cuisine under chef Javier Plascencia, with a selection of artisanal mezcals.

highlights.text: The spa's main highlight is its traditional temazcal, a Mexican sweat lodge used by ancient Aztecs to promote healing.
Casa Maat is a boutique retreat within the resort with personalized butler service.
The saltwater pool is made up of three tiered pools facing the ocean.
The terraced gardens include a sculpture by Jaume Plensa.

considerations.text: The resort is about 18.5 km from Los Cabos International Airport.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
